question: The first Indian woman to win a gold in World Universiade in 2019 is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dutee Chand**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dutee Chand** is the first Indian woman to win a gold medal in the World Universiade.
 
• She achieved this milestone in the year **2019**.
 
• The World Universiade, also known as the World University Games, is an international multi-sport event organized for university athletes by the International University Sports Federation (FISU).
 
• Dutee Chand won the gold medal in the **100 meters sprint** event.
 
• Her victory marked a significant achievement in Indian athletics, highlighting her as one of the country's top sprinters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dutee Chand** hails from Odisha, India, and has represented the country in various international competitions.
 
• She is also known for her advocacy for gender equality and LGBTQ+ rights, being one of the few openly gay athletes in India.
 
• In addition to her Universiade gold, Dutee has also won multiple medals in the Asian Games and Asian Championships.
 
• Her achievements have inspired many young athletes in India to pursue careers in sports.
